from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's operating cash flow report entry extracted from a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if provided in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., 2025 Q1)")
    operating_cash_flow_net: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities amount")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the cash flow value and context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root schema aggregating all extracted records from the document collection."""
    company_cash_flow_records: list[CompanyCashFlowRecord]
